result: Added probePanelDownloadControls(), which reports any Download control the applicant PANEL carries without pressing it. This is the measurement that decides whether the viewer open can be removed at all: the open only happens when the resume control carries a route and the document address exists nowhere on the page, and the one honest way to remove it is to press a Download control LinkedIn already shows on the panel - which this repo has never looked for, because rule 9i has only ever searched inside the viewer. inContainer is passed as false deliberately, so the verdict can never be allowed and no path can press what the probe finds; a label that cleared the denylist and matched the download allowlist surfaces as outside-resume-viewer, which is the signal wanted. The labels are logged per applicant by logResume, and the probe is skipped entirely when the address was already found. No rule amended, no control added, click budget still exactly seven.
